crossing: Call unchanged r1_events.track.crossing(N=8, engine), including its D=38/39 initial bracket, root and continuation gates, and maximum width 0.0078125 meV. This is the geometric center segment, not each engine-specific displaced transport path.
matched_path_gates: Same root, conditioning and adaptive numerical isolation thresholds as endpoints. No predetermined intermediate label. Compare relative labels across engines only for identical paths. Distinct paths may have distinct relative labels.
retention: Save each completed row and retain failed diagnostics. Endpoint and matched-path failures do not erase independent results. Crossing exceptions are retained. No threshold changes.
scope: N8 endpoint sensitivity, targeted center-segment crossing, and intermediate matched-path diagnostics. Reuses shared measurement framework; not external validation, full D-continuous tracking, exhaustive root counting, a braid certificate, Euler obstruction removal, novelty, or experimental feasibility. The local merger is cited from parent checkpoint, not recomputed here.
D_convention: Uniform layer potentials +/-D meV; difference 2D. D is not a calibrated experimental displacement field.
